description: R08 KeyBindings checkpoint: LayeredActionMap owns portable layering plus typed specialized action-argument semantics for fourteen Microsoft KeyBindingsTests contracts.

entries.notes: Multiple chords bind one semantic action while preserving independent lookup.
Later layers replace the same chord while distinct chords remain additive.
Identical splitPane commands deduplicate to one semantic action.
newTab default content args and index=0 keep distinct semantic hashes.
unbound/null/unknown/non-command inputs produce recoverable explicit unbinds.
Explicit-unbound state follows Microsoft bind/unbind/rebind transitions.
Scalar key syntax and default CopyText args are preserved.
Explicit action IDs support reverse ID-to-key lookup.
Copy/newTab/adjustFontSize typed defaults, explicit values, ignored unknown members and signed deltas reproduce Microsoft's ten-binding vector.
vertical/horizontal/default/auto split arguments project to Right/Down/Automatic exactly.
nullable/default tab colors and #RRGGBB to COLORREF projection are owned in Rust.
scroll defaults, rowsToScroll=10 and rejection of negative row counts match Microsoft.
default/action/commandLine launch modes and invalid-value rejection match Microsoft.
forward/backward directions, no-args unbind behavior and invalid-direction failure match Microsoft.
